facts.activity_file: handing back a partially completed isolation

control_failures.control_label: mechanical support of a load during maintenance access

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: prohibition notice - work stopped during a breakdown response on P-3222

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on P-3222 and PT-3222 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. P-3222 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 6 October 2008 a regulatory notice was issued concerning P-3222 and PT-3222 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following a breakdown response.
